search_yandex_api: search the web using Yandex Search API and return a list of SearchResult objects with urls, titles, and snippets
search_yandex_with_config: search Yandex with a custom JSON config payload to control search type, grouping mode, and result count
search_yandex_with_filter: search Yandex and filter results by a list of allowed domains before returning SearchResult objects
xml_element_contents_to_string: recursively extract all text content from an XML element including child elements and tail text
review_search_yandex: review the search_yandex function to understand how it constructs the Yandex API payload and parses XML responses
